May 17, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Arlington Value Capital Llc decreased its stake in Interactive Brokers Gro (IBKR) by 1.88% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Arlington Value Capital Llc sold 35,694 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.58% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 1.86 million shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $110.12M, down from 1.90 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Arlington Value Capital Llc who had been investing in Interactive Brokers Gro for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $32.20 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.08% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $78.2. About 428,441 shares traded. Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:IBKR) has risen 93.22% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 81.67% the S&P500.
